# Seeking Alpha

> Seeking Alpha is an investing research platform offering stock analysis, market news, portfolio tools, screeners, and earnings resources for individual investors.

Seeking Alpha combines editorial coverage, contributor research, quantitative ratings, earnings materials, and portfolio monitoring tools across stocks, ETFs, funds, and macro markets.

## Core Platform
- [Home](https://seekingalpha.com/): Main entry point for market analysis, investing tools, and research content.
- [Latest Articles](https://seekingalpha.com/latest-articles): Stream of newly published investment analysis and opinion pieces.
- [News](https://seekingalpha.com/news): Real-time market and company news coverage for investors.
- [Market Data](https://seekingalpha.com/market-data): Quotes, movers, and market-wide performance data.
- [Stock Ideas](https://seekingalpha.com/stock-ideas): Curated investing ideas and actionable research themes.
- [Authors](https://seekingalpha.com/authors): Directory of contributors publishing stock and market analysis.
- [Top Stocks](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/AAPL): Example symbol page showing ratings, news, analysis, and financial data.

## Markets & Quotes
- [Stocks](https://seekingalpha.com/market-data/stocks): Market overview and quote access for publicly traded stocks.
- [ETFs](https://seekingalpha.com/market-data/etfs): ETF quotes, performance data, and related research coverage.
- [Mutual Funds](https://seekingalpha.com/market-data/mutual-funds): Mutual fund data and research entry points.
- [Commodities](https://seekingalpha.com/market-data/commodities): Commodity prices, market moves, and related coverage.
- [Cryptocurrencies](https://seekingalpha.com/market-data/cryptocurrencies): Crypto market prices and news-oriented market data.
- [Forex](https://seekingalpha.com/market-data/forex): Foreign exchange market data and currency pair performance.
- [Indices](https://seekingalpha.com/market-data/indices): Major index performance, quotes, and market context.

## Research & Analysis
- [Analysis](https://seekingalpha.com/analysis): In-depth contributor research on stocks, sectors, and macro themes.
- [Dividend Ideas](https://seekingalpha.com/dividends): Dividend-focused analysis, ratings, and income investing content.
- [Growth Stocks](https://seekingalpha.com/growth): Growth-oriented stock research and investing ideas.
- [Value Stocks](https://seekingalpha.com/value): Value investing analysis and undervalued stock coverage.
- [REITs](https://seekingalpha.com/reits): Real estate investment trust analysis and sector commentary.
- [Macro View](https://seekingalpha.com/market-outlook): Macro, rates, inflation, and economic market outlook content.
- [Wall Street Breakfast](https://seekingalpha.com/tag/wall-street-breakfast): Daily market roundup and key events summary.

## Ratings & Quant Tools
- [Ratings](https://seekingalpha.com/ratings): Central hub for Seeking Alpha stock and fund ratings.
- [Quant Ratings](https://seekingalpha.com/quant): Quantitative ratings and factor-based investment signals.
- [Factor Grades](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/AAPL/ratings/quant-ratings): Example ratings page with valuation, growth, and profitability factors.
- [Dividend Grades](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/AAPL/dividends/scorecard): Example dividend scorecard for yield and safety metrics.
- [Profitability](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/AAPL/ratings/quant-ratings): Example factor view covering profitability and momentum signals.
- [Revisions](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/AAPL/earnings/estimates): Example earnings estimates and analyst revisions page.

## Earnings & Financials
- [Earnings](https://seekingalpha.com/earnings/earnings-calendar): Earnings calendar for upcoming company reports and events.
- [Earnings Call Transcripts](https://seekingalpha.com/earnings/earnings-call-transcripts): Archive of public company earnings call transcripts.
- [Earnings Calendar](https://seekingalpha.com/earnings/earnings-calendar): Scheduled earnings releases by date and company.
- [Earnings News](https://seekingalpha.com/tag/earnings): Earnings-related news, previews, and reaction coverage.
- [Financial Statements](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/AAPL/financials): Example company financial statements and historical results.
- [Income Statement](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/AAPL/income-statement): Example income statement with annual and quarterly data.
- [Balance Sheet](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/AAPL/balance-sheet): Example balance sheet with assets, liabilities, and equity.
- [Cash Flow Statement](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/AAPL/cash-flow-statement): Example cash flow statement and operating cash metrics.

## Screeners & Portfolio Tools
- [Stock Screener](https://seekingalpha.com/screeners/stock): Filter stocks by valuation, growth, dividends, and other metrics.
- [ETF Screener](https://seekingalpha.com/screeners/etf): Screen ETFs using performance, expense, and holdings criteria.
- [Portfolio](https://seekingalpha.com/portfolio): Track holdings, watchlists, and portfolio performance in one place.
- [Watchlist](https://seekingalpha.com/portfolio/watchlist): Monitor selected securities and related news or ratings.
- [Alerts](https://seekingalpha.com/account/email-alerts): Manage email alerts for symbols, authors, and market events.
- [My Authors](https://seekingalpha.com/my-authors): Follow preferred contributors and monitor their latest publications.

## Newsletters & Premium Products
- [Alpha Picks](https://seekingalpha.com/alpha-picks): Premium stock-picking service featuring curated investment selections.
- [Seeking Alpha Premium](https://seekingalpha.com/premium): Subscription product with ratings, screeners, and deeper research tools.
- [PRO](https://seekingalpha.com/pro): Premium market news and analysis product for active investors.
- [Newsletters](https://seekingalpha.com/newsletters): Directory of Seeking Alpha newsletters and editorial products.
- [Marketplace](https://seekingalpha.com/marketplace): Subscription investing services from independent analysts and teams.

## Learning & Help
- [How to Use Seeking Alpha](https://seekingalpha.com/page/how-to-use-seeking-alpha): Introductory guidance for navigating the platform and tools.
- [Help Center](https://help.seekingalpha.com/): Support articles for accounts, billing, alerts, and product usage.
- [About](https://seekingalpha.com/page/about_us): Company overview and platform background.
- [Terms of Use](https://seekingalpha.com/page/terms-of-use): Legal terms governing use of the platform and content.
- [Privacy Policy](https://seekingalpha.com/page/privacy-policy): Privacy practices for accounts, data, and site usage.
- [Contact Us](https://seekingalpha.com/page/contact_us): Contact options for support, business, and general inquiries.

## Community & Publishing
- [Trending Analysis](https://seekingalpha.com/trending-analysis): Popular analysis articles gaining investor attention.
- [Top News](https://seekingalpha.com/news/top-news): Most important and widely read market news items.
- [Comments](https://seekingalpha.com/): Article discussions and investor commentary across published content.
- [Become a Contributor](https://seekingalpha.com/page/become-a-seeking-alpha-contributor): Information for analysts interested in publishing on the platform.
- [Contributor Hub](https://seekingalpha.com/author-dashboard): Workspace for managing submissions and author activity.
- [Editors' Picks](https://seekingalpha.com/editors-picks): Selected articles highlighted by the editorial team.
